interpretation: Definitional equivalence. A 1m HILO = a market-structure shift on the seconds chart. A 1m HVCS = the overextension on the seconds chart. So 'HVCS -> HILO' = a seconds overextension into a seconds shift, the same pattern one tier down (and a 1m extension + 1m shift = 5m HVCS + 5m HILO). Supports defining HILO as a candle that takes one side of the prior candle then the other (OQ-09 default), measured on the entry tier.
